title.narrative: Stepping Up Universal Access: A Multi-Sectoral Partnership Response to TB/HIV - Lesotho (01-Jul-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Lesotho, TB/HIV, Ministry of Finance of the Kingdom of Lesotho (MOF)This program has the following goals: Reduced HIV incidence by at least 75% from current baselines, by 2023. Reduced AIDS Related deaths by 50% from current baselines, by 2023. Mother to child transmission of HIV eliminated, (from 6% to less than 2%), by 2023. To reduce the overall mortality of TB by 75%. To reduce the overall incidence of TB by 50%. The objectives of this program are: To achieve 95% access to combination prevention by 2023. To Eliminate Mother to Child Transmission and have 95% of children living with HIV on treatment by 2023. To ensure that 75% of PLHIV, at risk of and affected by HIV benefit from HIV-sensitive social protection by 2023. To ensure that at least 40% of the HIV/TB response is community-led and sustained by 2023. To ensure that Health System is people-centered, and sustainably integrates HIV, TB, and other infections by 2023. To Fast Track Test and Treat Cascade to attain 95-95-95 targets by 2023. To find 90% of all incident TB cases in the general public (NSP Objective 1) and among vulnerable populations (NSP Objective 4) and place cases notified on appropriate treatment. To find 90% of the incident drug-resistant TB cases, place all of them on appropriate treatment and successfully treat 75% of them, irrespectively of their HIV status (NSP Objective 3). To increase efficiencies and financial investments in HIV and TB programs from 60% to 90% of the NSP budget by 2023. To increase the workload capacity of the TB laboratory services to more than 67 000 Xpert MTB/RIF tests per year (NSP Objective 5) and enhance stewardship in the National TB Programme and maximize resources for the achievement of the strategic goals (NSP Objective 6). To remove Gender and Human Rights Related Barriers to service delivery, accessibility and utilization by 2023. To treat successfully 90% of all drug-susceptible TB patients, irrespectively of their HIV status (NSP Objective 2) and vulnerability (NSP Objective 4)

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for LSO-C-MOFP02
TB/HIV mortality rate per 100,000 population
Percentage of people living with HIV
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LSO-C-MOFP02
Percentage of other vulnerable populations that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of newly diagnosed people linked to HIV care (individual linkage)
Percentage of other vulnerable populations reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Number of medical male circumcisions performed according to national standards
Percentage of ART sites that had a stock-out of any antiretroviral drugs during the reporting period
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of people who were tested for HIV and received their results during the reporting period
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART, who have a suppressed viral load at 12 months (<1000 copies/ml)
TCP-Other: Number of children <15 in contact with TB patients who began isonizide preventive therapy
Outcome indicators targets and results for LSO-C-MOFP02
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percent of respondents who say they used a condom the last time they had sex with a non-marital, non-cohabiting partner, of those who have had sex with such a partner in the last 12 months
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
